<function name="RetrieveUserName" parent="WorkshopFileBase" type="classfunc">
	<description>
		Retrieves the username for the given SteamID.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="steamid" type="string">SteamID to retrieve the name for</arg>
		<arg name="callback" type="function">Callback function.
		<callback>
			<arg type="string" name="name">The retrieved name</arg>
		</callback></arg>
	</args>
</function>
